name: SwipeActions
description: Swipe a row to reveal trailing actions; dismiss-to-delete; RTL-aware with a keyboard/semantics alternative.
notes: Density-sized by default: compact tile ~56 wide, icon 16, label 12; comfortable and touch grow from the tokens.
The reveal scales with the drag; a full swipe collapses the row height to zero before onDismissed fires.
The actions are density tiles (Clickable): keyboard focus and screen readers reach them once revealed; closed rows exclude them from semantics and focus.
Gap-fill primitive for the P9-3 flows (checkout cart rows, chat threads).
